seo_title: Cost of Living in Aktau 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Aktau per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A city on the shore of the Caspian Sea: visa-free for Russian citizens, the Russian language in everyday life and access to the sea in the middle of the steppe. A young city without the usual street names (it uses microdistricts), a dry climate and strong winds.
